n: Day of AI Seasonal and Monthly Activities
t: A page of 12 Day of AI activities and units from PreK to grade 12.
steps: Find the Day of AI activities page on the Day of AI site.
Read the list and choose one activity for your grade.
Register with an email if the site asks for a login link.
Read the Day of AI privacy notice.
Open the activity and read its guide.
Check the length and tools the activity needs.
Run the activity and note what to change.
